record.description: TRICORP is an innovative leader financing economic development initiatives among First Nations members on the North Coast. TRICORPs loan portfolio includes individuals, partnerships, companies and joint ventures which are 51% owned/controlled by First Nations. TRICORPs loans portfolio reflects the Northwest economy.  As the economy has changed and shifted, Tricorp's loan portfolio is no longer predominately invested in the fishing and forestry sectors.  In most recent years, there has been a  dramatic increase in the tourism, hospitality and trades industries.
